tools.name: flows_apply_copilot_changes
tools.title: Apply the accepted copilot changes to a flow as one new ver…
tools.description: Apply the accepted copilot changes to a flow as one new version and record what was rejected.

flow_id.description: The flow (id or name); default: the only one of this workspace.

message_id.description: The copilot turn the changes come from: message_id of flows_ask_copilot or flows_get_copilot_history.

accept.description: Ids of the changes to apply, comma-separated (at most 50).

reject.description: Ids of the changes to record as rejected, comma-separated (at most 50).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_ask_copilot
tools.title: Ask the flow copilot for changes to a flow
tools.description: Ask the flow copilot for changes to a flow; without a message it runs its standard review. Returns a proposal, changes nothing.

flow_id.description: The flow (id or name); default: the only one of this workspace.

message.description: What to ask; without it the copilot runs its standard review.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_duplicate
tools.title: Duplicate flows, or copy one flow onto another docs version
tools.description: Duplicate flows, or copy one flow onto another docs version (docs_id).

flow_ids.description: The flows to copy, ids or names, comma-separated (1-20; exactly one with docs_id).

docs_id.description: Copy the flow onto this documentation version.

name.description: The name of the copy (with docs_id).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_export_walk_image
tools.title: Export a walk image to a local file
tools.description: Export a walk image to a local file and return its path: a live snapshot of a path attempt, or a timeline still.

walk_id.description: The walk: its handle or id; default: the walk of this workspace.

path_index.description: The step of the walk to capture live (not with still_id).

attempt.description: The attempt of that step (with path_index).

still_id.description: A still of the review timeline (not with path_index).

overwrite.description: true: replace an image saved earlier under the same name.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_get
tools.title: Get one flow as a numbered outline with variables
tools.description: Get one flow as a numbered outline with variables, pauses and open questions.

flow_id.description: The flow: its id or name; default: the only flow of this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_get_copilot_history
tools.title: Get a flow's copilot conversation
tools.description: Get a flow's copilot conversation, or its improvement suggestions.

flow_id.description: The flow: its id or name; default: the only flow of this workspace.

suggestions.description: true: the copilot's open suggestions instead of the conversation.

limit.description: How many of the latest turns to return (1-50).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_get_versions
tools.title: Get a flow's stored versions
tools.description: Get a flow's stored versions: the list, or one version as an outline.

flow_id.description: The flow: its id or name; default: the only flow of this workspace.

version.description: One version as an outline; without it, the list (newest first).

limit.description: How many versions of the list to return (1-100).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_get_walks
tools.title: Get description runs
tools.description: Get description runs (browser walks): the list, or one with its paths and optional review timeline.

walk_id.description: One walk: its handle or id; without it, the list of your walks.

limit.description: How many walks of the list to return (1-50).

include.description: "timeline": the review timeline of the walk (with walk_id only).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_list
tools.title: List the project's flows
tools.description: List the project's flows: name, type, version, step count.

query.description: Only flows whose name contains this text (any case).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_merge
tools.title: Merge several flows into one new flow
tools.description: Merge several flows into one new flow (the first kept whole, later ones lose their leading reads).

flow_ids.description: The flows to merge, ids or names, comma-separated (2-20).

name.description: The name of the merged flow.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_regenerate
tools.title: Regenerate a flow from its recorded sources
tools.description: Regenerate a flow from its recorded sources; saved as a new version.

flow_id.description: The flow (id or name); default: the only one of this workspace.

description.description: What the flow should do; default: the description it was generated from.

skip_validators.description: true: do not generate validators for the new version.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_restore_version
tools.title: Restore an older flow version as the newest one
tools.description: Restore an older flow version as the newest one.

flow_id.description: The flow: its id or name; default: the only flow of this workspace.

version.description: The version to bring back (flows_get_versions lists them).

reason.description: Why the version is restored (kept with the new version).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_save
tools.title: Save a flow from blocks
tools.description: Save a flow from blocks (flow_id: new version; none: new flow). Direct edit, only on the user's request; normally use flows_ask_copilot.

flow_id.description: The flow to change (id or name); without it, a new flow is created.

name.description: The flow's name; required for a new flow.

graph.description: The whole graph {blocks, edges, entry_block_id} (no variables); a new flow or a full replacement.

drop_steps.description: Step numbers to remove, as flows_get numbers them, comma-separated (at most 50); with flow_id, not with graph.

reason.description: Why the graph changes (with graph or drop_steps); kept on the new version.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_save_walk_note
tools.title: Save a note at a step of a walk
tools.description: Save a note at a step of a walk (new or changed); notes steer the next retry.

walk_id.description: The walk: its handle or id; default: the walk of this workspace.

step.description: The step of the walk (from flows_get_walks include timeline).

note_id.description: An existing note to change; without it, a new note.

remember.description: true: also keep it as a note of the project for later walks.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: flows_set_poll_terminals
tools.title: Set the success and failure terminal statuses that answer a…
tools.description: Set the success and failure terminal statuses that answer a flow's open poll-loop questions.

flow_id.description: The flow (id or name); default: the only one of this workspace.

field.description: The status field of an open poll question: the field of a poll_status item in flows_get.

success_terminals.description: The statuses that mean the job succeeded, comma-separated (at most 20).

failure_terminals.description: The statuses that mean it failed, comma-separated (at most 20); without it, none.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
